stages.journal: The Barrowlight lies somewhere inside the barrow of the Ashen Order. Find a way in.
A sealed bronze door bars the way deeper into the barrow. Its three sigils (sun, moon, and skull) must hold the key.
The bronze door stands open. Whatever guards the Barrowlight waits in the Barrow Heart beyond.
The guardian of the Barrow Heart no longer stands in your way. Claim the Barrowlight.
The Barrowlight burns in your hand, and its waking flame has unsealed a hidden stair beneath the sarcophagus leading deep into the earth.
You carried the Barrowlight down through the unsealed threshold into the Under-Barrow.
You descended the Weeping Stair into the Under-Barrow. Ahead in the cavernous twilight glimmer the pale lanterns of Nocturne.

Nocturne's central beacon stands dark in the sunken cathedral square. Its resonant tuning-tongue and smoked-glass lens were carried off toward the Echo Chapel in the east and the Drowned Tollbridge in the west.
You have recovered one of the two missing pieces of Nocturne's beacon. The other still lies in the dark at the opposite spoke of the cavern.
You hold both the Resonant Tuning-Tongue and the Smoked-Glass Beacon Lens. Return to the Lantern Market in Nocturne and restore the central beacon.
You rekindled Nocturne's central beacon. Its warm chime steadies the spirits of the Lantern Market against both the Hollow Choir's tethers and the Ashen patrol's quarantine.

name: The Twin Seals of the Warrens

stages.journal: Beyond the Drowned Tollbridge stands the Gate of the Twin Seals, barring the descent into the Cradle of the First Architect. To open it, you must recover the Seal of the Waxing Moon from the Archive of Unkept Vows to the north and the Seal of the Unclouded Sun from the Iron Reliquary to the south.
You have claimed one of the two Triad Seals from the factions of the Memory Warrens. The second seal still rests in the opposing stronghold.
You hold both the Seal of the Waxing Moon and the Seal of the Unclouded Sun. Return to the Gate of the Twin Seals at the crossroads and unseal the descent.
You set both Triad Seals into the bronze gate at the crossroads, unsealing the way down to the Cradle of the First Architect.

name: The Cradle of the First Architect

stages.journal: You descended beneath the Gate of the Twin Seals onto the Stair of the Uncarved Skull, where the Third Pillar of the Triad was chiseled out of the stone three centuries ago.

Beyond the Vigil of the Last Watch, you stood beneath the Great Vesper Bell—cracked from crown to lip by three hundred years of accumulated memory-salt. The Cradle of the First Architect lies just ahead.

The First Architect no longer bars the dais. The Great Brazier of the Under-Barrow stands open before you, waiting for you to choose whether to relight the Sun's stasis, tune the Moon's vigil, or restore the Complete Triad of Passage.
At the Great Brazier in the bedrock of the Under-Barrow, you made your choice and answered the last question of Greywater.
